content.short: MAY.Social is a mobile-friendly social metaverse platform that enables multi-person interactions.
content.description: MAY.Social is the world’s first mobile-friendly social metaverse infrastructure that enables multi-person interactions without the need for VR hardware. It lets communities build NFT-based virtual worlds they can own, operate, and trade, while connecting Web2 and Web3 users through social events, games, and NFT/token incentives. For consumers, MAY delivers mobile, immersive interaction and groups people by their NFTs. For partners, MAY for Business is a serverless metaverse service that can be integrated into existing web products in as little as one hour.

resources.title: A Metaverse Without the Headset
resources.tldr: NFT-gated virtual spaces built for a phone screen, on the bet that hardware is what kept social metaverses empty.

resources.title: Communities That Own Their World
resources.tldr: Token holdings decide who gets in, and the events, games and quests inside are run by the community rather than the platform.
